title: Range and cycle inversion for the affine k-plane transform
statement: Characterize the rapidly decreasing affine \(k\)-plane transform data by differential conditions, and recover the original function by integration over a suitable cycle of directions; specify which cycle classes give a nonzero coefficient.
status: As of November 2026: the precise range theorem for \(1\leq k<n-1\) and the complex cycle inversion theorem are established in \citet{gelfand1967planes}. The notebook does not specify an additional open family-selection problem.
